prayerExcerpt.en-US: God gives not the kingdom of heaven but on condition that we labor; and all we can do bears no proportion to such a crown.
prayerExcerpt.pt-BR: Deus não dá o reino dos céus senão com a condição de que trabalhemos; e tudo o que podemos fazer não guarda proporção com tal coroa.

meta.face: A Palestinian of about eighty-five, lean and sun-browned, with a SMALL, NARROW face of SHARP, BIRD-LIKE features under a high, POLISHED BALD dome — PINCHED temples, a THIN, SHARP, POINTED nose, SMALL, piercing, CLOSE-SET black eyes under TUFTED, bristling white brows, tight, thin lips; a LONG, straight, silver-white beard to the breast, narrow and combed; the gaze alert and searching, toward us.
meta.basis: The Painter's Manual (Hermeneia) describes 'Epiphanius of Cyprus, an old man, bald, with a white beard', and the Serbian fresco on Wikipedia shows him so, bald with a long white beard, in an omophorion with a book. The book tells his monastic life in Egypt and Palestine, his saying on labour and the crown, his election at Salamis about 367, and his zeal; its engraving shows a monk with a staff in a desert. Wikipedia's Salamis names the basilica of Bishop Epiphanius in the rebuilt city of Constantia. The small, sharp, bird-like face is our choice within that type.
